summary: QuotientIQ V4 testing complete. All 5 new V4 features verified: Conversations Explorer (list, export, delete with cross-user isolation), Embed rate-limiting (40/visitor/hour enforced, different visitor still works, 41st returns 429), embed_hits TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=3600 confirmed via direct Mongo inspection), Markdown rendering for assistant messages in both main chat and public embed page, and Conversations sidebar nav. All 42 prior backend tests still pass. Backend: 47/47 pytest cases passing in ~49s. Frontend: /conversations page loads with 25 existing rows, sidebar nav-conversations works, search + agent filter + source filter all rendered with correct data-testids, export/delete buttons per row. Markdown rendering verified live: user prompt 'Reply ONLY with: **bold** ...' produces a rendered bold in the assistant bubble while the user bubble keeps literal '**bold**' (correct behavior). Code review confirms Embed.jsx and MessageList.jsx both wrap assistant content with MarkdownMessage component, user content stays plain text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1170+ lines — modularization (auth, agents, conversations, embed, billing into separate routers) is correctly deferred to a follow-up iteration as called out by the main agent.
POST /api/conversations/{id}/export returns raw conversation including potentially large messages array; consider streaming or pagination if message history grows beyond a few MB per conversation.

The 40 LLM calls performed by the rate-limit test consume real Emergent LLM quota each run — acceptable but worth knowing. The test cleans up gracefully via per-test unique visitor_ids; the existing 1-hour TTL handles eventual cleanup of embed_hits docs.
list_all_conversations issues 3 sequential awaits (find, aggregate, agents lookup). Acceptable at 200 conv cap but could be parallelized with asyncio.gather for slight latency win.
delete_conversation has no soft-delete / audit trail; consider for compliance use cases.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 5 new test classes: TestConversationsExplorer, TestEmbedRateLimit, TestEmbedHitsTTL with 5 new tests)
seed_data_creation: Fresh agents created per-test and torn down (or left to natural expiry). Embed rate-limit test uses unique uuid-based visitor_ids per test invocation to avoid clobbering across runs; embed_hits TTL=3600s purges old hits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 47-test pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all features through V4. Run with: ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@quotientiq.com REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://quotient-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v . The rate-limit test makes 40 real LLM calls (~40s) — keep that in mind. Frontend /conversations page has full data-testid coverage (conv-list, conv-row-{id}, conv-search, conv-agent-filter, conv-source-filter, conv-export-{id}, conv-delete-{id}, conv-empty, conv-loading) and sidebar nav-conversations. MarkdownMessage component used in MessageList.jsx and Embed.jsx for assistant role only.
